description_en: Retrieves the timestamps of all screenshots that contain violations
description_zh: 调用本接口获取到所有违规内容截图的时间点
name: GetMediaAuditResultTimeline

MediaAuditResultTimeline.description_en: The collection of automated review result timelines
MediaAuditResultTimeline.description_zh: 审核结果时间线的集合

Ad.description_en: The collection of advertisement detection timelines

Label.description_en:
The classification of the advertisement detection result. Valid values:
normal: normal.
ad: other advertisements.
politics: text contains political content.
porn: text contains pornographic content.
abuse: text contains abusive content.
terrorism: text contains terrorism-related content.
contraband: text contains prohibited content.
spam: text contains other spam content.
npx: psoriasis advertisements.
qrcode: contains a QR code.
programCode: contains a mini program code
Label.description_zh:
广告审核结果分类。取值：
normal：正常。
ad：其他广告。
politics：文字含涉政内容。
porn：文字含涉黄内容。
abuse：文字含辱骂内容。
terrorism：文字含暴恐内容。
contraband：文字含违禁内容。
spam：文字含其他垃圾内容。
npx：牛皮癣广告。
qrcode：含二维码。
programCode：含小程序码

Score.description_en: The hit score of the video screenshot for the advertisement detection result. Value range: `[0-100]`, with a precision of 10 decimal places. The hit result indicates the probability of the corresponding classification label. A higher value indicates higher accuracy
Score.description_zh: 广告审核结果的视频截图的命中分数。取值为：`[0-100]`，精度小数点后10位。命中结果为对应分类Label的概率，值越高则命中准确性越高

Timestamp.description_en: The position of the video screenshot in the video. Unit: milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 视频截图在视频中的位置。单位：毫秒

drivelive: in-car live streaming
